ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (17) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Разум» (razum, 'reason') is 'reason' throughout, and Pascal's «разумение» (razumenie) and «разуметь» (razumet') are 'understanding' and 'to understand', so the reed is 'endowed with understanding'. Channing's «божественное начало» (bozhestvennoe nachalo) is 'the divine principle'; the paragraph on the frailty of man that follows Pascal's attribution is translated where it is printed.

Source observation: [10] The paragraph «Какого-нибудь пустяка достаточно, чтобы убить человека…» stands after the attribution «Паскаль.», unquoted, at the head of p. 441; its thought is Pascal's (the reed fragment), so the attribution may be misplaced or the paragraph may be Tolstoy's own sequel. Translated as printed, unattributed.
